Messages.Author: prestonp
Messages.Body:
Byzar
>
> Sabbat: If Byzar would be burned, put a burn counter on him and move him to torpor instead. If he has three burn counters, remove him from the game. +1 stealth.
>
Anathema
>
> Choose a ready vampire. If the referendum is successful, put this card on that vampire. If the vampire with this card is reduced to zero blood in combat, he or she is burned, and the Methuselah controlling the opposing minion gains pool equal to the burned vampire's capacity.
>
So if Byzar has an Anthema and is reduced to zero in combat what happens? I'm gathering he gains a burn counter and goes to torpor, but does the opposing minion's controller gain pool?

He gains a burn counter, goes to torpor and nothing else happens, similarily to Anathema + Reform Body:

groups.google.com/d/topic/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/TLNFS9u14lY/discussion

Name: Reform Body
[Sabbat:R, SW:PT]
Cardtype: Combat/Reaction
Discipline: Vicissitude
[vic] Only usable by a vampire being burned; he or she is sent into torpor instead. Usable by a vampire in torpor. Usable by a tapped vampire.
[VIC] As above, and this vampire gains 2 blood from the blood bank.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
Pascal:
Can I ask for a follow-up on this?

Anathema + Byzar with 2 Counters on him.
What happens when Byzar gains a third counter?

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418

Messages.Author: jamesatzephyr
Messages.Body:
> Juggernaut1981 wrote:
> Anathema + Byzar with 2 Counters on him.
> What happens when Byzar gains a third counter?
>
He would be burned, but goes to torpor instead (his card text) and gets his third counter. No pool is gained, because there is no "burned vampire", which Anathema gives you pool equal to.

Now Byzar has three counters and is removed from the game, which isn't burning. So he's removed from the game.

Messages.Author: Juggernaut1981
Messages.Body:
James, in classic hairsplitting... and I was wanting PB to just stick it on the record in his role as the Rule Guy.
He gains the counter before going to torpor and is then removed from the game instead of reaching torpor.

Retired Baron of Sydney, Australia, 418
